quests.canDoWhy: A bounty in The Reach: the target and where it is are picked when the bounty starts, but these records don't show what offers it.
quests.firstStep: Kill the leader of the place named in your journal

takesYou.place: the place named in the bounty (picked when it starts)
takesYou.why: kill the leader there

takesYou.place: Understone Keep in Markarth
takesYou.why: collect the bounty from the steward or the jarl

objectives: Kill the leader of the place named in your journal
Collect the bounty from the steward
Collect the bounty from the jarl

rewards.when: when you collect the bounty from the steward or jarl

people.name: the steward of The Reach
people.role: pays the bounty, at Understone Keep in Markarth

people.name: the jarl of The Reach
people.role: pays the bounty if the journal sends you to the jarl instead, at Understone Keep in Markarth

unsure.why: These records show nothing that hands you this bounty in The Reach: no dialogue line, no letter and no start event point to it. The quest has slots for an innkeeper and a letter, which suggests an innkeeper or a letter hands it to you (the steward's slot is where you collect, not where it starts), but that can't be confirmed here. The game's own shared bounty quests are still the ones wired to start when you enter a hold.
Because no start is recorded for this copy, it may never be offered in a normal game; it may only run if something outside these files starts it.
The place to clear is picked when the bounty starts, so it changes from game to game. The hold is The Reach going by how the quest is set up; the exact place isn't in these files.

The steward and jarl are filled in when the quest starts. Understone Keep in Markarth is the hold's seat in the records, but who sits there can change during the war, and their daily schedules weren't checked.

The quest's script hands out gold when you collect, going by its reward property; the amount isn't in these files and the hand-over isn't confirmed. The game's own shared version of this bounty also hands out an extra reward from Requiem; this hold copy's script lists only gold.
The journal can send you to either the steward or the jarl to collect; what decides which one isn't in these files.
